source.title: Phase III of Recombinant Human Activated Protein C and Low Dose of Hydrocortisone and Fludrocortisone in Adult Septic Shock

eligibility.text: minimumAge: 18 Years
hospitalized in intensive care unit for less than 7 days
septic shock for less than 24 hours
at least one proven site of infection
at least 2 organ dysfunction as defined by a SOFA score =or> to 3 for at least 6 consecutive hours

need for vasopressor (dopamine =or>15µg/kg/min or epinephrine/norepinephrine at =or>0,25 µg/kg/min for at least 6 consecutive hours, to maintain systolic arterial pressure at 90 mmHg or more OR mean arterial pressure at 6( mmHg or more
informed consent
pregnancy or breath feeding
decision not to resuscitate
underlying disease with an estimated life expectancy of less than 1 month
formal indication for corticosteroids
recent surgery (ie within the past 72 hours) or a surgery at high risk of bleeding

time_zero.anchor_event: first time septic shock is diagnosed and all inclusion criteria are met, including need for vasopressors and at least 2 organ dysfunctions as defined by a SOFA score >= 3 for at least 6 consecutive hours
time_zero.rationale: Time zero is defined as the moment when septic shock is diagnosed and all inclusion criteria are met, including vasopressor use and organ dysfunction, to align with the trial's treatment initiation point and avoid immortal time bias.
time_zero.evidence: Inclusion criteria: - hospitalized in intensive care unit for less than 7 days (removed on 11/06/2010) - septic shock for less than 24 hours - at least one proven site of infection - at least 2 organ dysfunction as defined by a SOFA score =or> to 3 for at least 6 consecutive hours - need for vasopressor (dopamine =or>15µg/kg/min or epinephrine/norepinephrine at =or>0,25 µg/kg/min for at least 6 consecutive hours, to maintain systolic arterial pressure at 90 mmHg or more OR mean arterial pressure at 6( mmHg or more - informed consent
